# Safepay

> Safepay is an escrow-style payment app for India. Buyers pay through Safepay, funds are locked until delivery is confirmed, and refunded automatically if the seller fails to deliver. Built for social-commerce purchases on Instagram, WhatsApp, and independent stores.

## Pages

- [Home](/): How Safepay protects online payments — escrow-style buyer protection, dispute resolution, refunds.
- [About](/about): Company overview and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, grievance, and compliance contacts.
- [Customer Signup](/customer-signup): Create a buyer account (phone + password).
- [Customer Login](/customer-login): Sign in as a buyer.
- [Merchant Signup](/merchant-signup): Create a seller account.
- [Merchant Login](/merchant-login): Sign in as a seller.
